I told Pree the site is **Pine Crossing**, in a thread reply to their message in #central-team.

That comes from #central-team, a channel Pree is in. On 9 June 2026 Pree posted that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he would check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem with the store login.

Neither the channel nor the shared files Pree can see give an address or site code for Pine Crossing, so I said they'd need to get those from the account record. I only used what Pree can see: no DMs, no `search_messages`, and the Marrow account folder in the shared files is empty to them.
